title: The three states of a results panel
why: Loading, error and empty are where a screen is most often finished by hand: a div that says "No results", a tinted box for the error, and a CSS spinner nobody else in the product has. Spinner, Alert and EmptyState own all three, and the failure is not laziness — the happy path is what a task describes, so the other three states get invented on the spot.

forbidden.message: hand-rolled spinner — use <Spinner>, or <Button loading> inside a button
